title: A general-purpose global regularization method for 3D volume integral operators
summary: Singular volume integral operators associated with constant-coefficient partial differential operators extend the applicability of potential theory to inhomogeneous problems, for example arising from nonlinearities or variable coefficients. Typically the PDE kernels in these operators give rise to singularities at all $\mathcal{O}(1/h^3)$ volume discretization/evaluation points in a mesh of characteristic size $h$, while the slowly-decaying nature of such kernels give rise to long-range interactions that require coupling to fast summation algorithms.
